label: prop:ns-kummer-specialisation
title: Kummer specialisation: the NS obstruction survives $q = 1$ for $\gcd(\chi(A), n) \neq n$
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) isolate a valid QOU bearing \kappa_0 = e(\xi) \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m) constrained by \mathrm{tr}(\kappa_0) = \chi(A).

The strict Kummer exact sequence evaluated at any integer n \geq 1:

  1 \to \mu_n \to \mathbb{G}_m
  \xrightarrow{(\cdot)^n} \mathbb{G}_m \to 1

forces a long exact sequence mapping through cohomology:

  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mu_n)
  \to H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m)
  \xrightarrow{\cdot n}
  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m)
  \to H^3(\mathcal{S}, \mu_n).

The specialisation driving q = 1 projects cleanly:

  \kappa_0 \mapsto
  \kappa_0 \bmod n
   \in 
  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m) / nH^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m).

The resulting class avoids zero if and only if \kappa_0 resists n-divisibility. Evaluated against any QOU with \chi(A) \neq 0:

  1. The exact specialisation \kappa_0|_{q=1} avoids zero within H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m)/n for all integers n \nmid \chi(A).
  2. The integer set \{n : n \nmid \chi(A)\} extends to infinity (encompassing all primes not dividing \chi(A)), so the obstruction remains persistently nonzero, piercing infinitely many levels of the Kummer tower.
  3. The obstruction vanishes only at the finite, isolated Kummer levels n \mid \chi(A), which align with the finite set of roots of unity where the category's truncation is compatible with the fixed Euler class.

What persistence does and does not buy (the genericity caveat). Items 2 and 3 say the set of surviving Kummer levels is cofinite. That measures how cheap the condition is, not how strong — and here the cofiniteness is elementary arithmetic: only n \in \{1, 2, 3, 6\} divide -6, so the obstruction persists at every other level for no reason having to do with fluid dynamics. (The analogous statement for the substrate parameter q — a nonzero polynomial obstruction has cofinite non-vanishing locus — is ObstructionGenericity, sorry-free. It is a parallel fact over a different index set, not the same one; do not cite it for the level-indexed claim.) A cheap condition cannot by itself be equivalent to a uniform statement without collapsing the equivalence.

Consequently "persistently nonzero" is not by itself evidence that the NS obstruction is a faithful regularity criterion. It is the Navier--Stokes instance of the barrier the \mathrm{P} versus \mathrm{NP} leg already records (\mathrm{P} \neq \mathrm{NP} at non-torsion q) [aaronsonwigderson2009, grochow2017]. The blow-up conclusion that consumes this proposition (the Descartes universe is NS-singular) inherits the caveat — as that block already says for the separate categorical-to-classical bridge, the QOU-internal verdict is not a resolution of the classical regularity problem.

Note also that the divisibility structure is what makes the verdict level-dependent: at \chi(A) = -6 the obstruction vanishes at levels n \in \{1, 2, 3, 6\} while persisting at all others. Different restrictions of \kappa_0 therefore carry different verdicts at once, and the shared class transfers nothing between the Millennium legs (ObstructionVerdictCap).

The regularity content therefore sits in the filtration — whether the vortex-knot complexity stays bounded (one length filtration, three problems) — not in the non-vanishing of the class alone.

Proof.

(a) Divisibility of the Euler class.

Constrained over a closed orientable surface \Sigma_g anchored at genus g: H^2(\Sigma_g, \mathbb{Z}) \cong \mathbb{Z}. The bare Euler class scales as e(\xi) = \chi(A) \in \mathbb{Z}. Therefore:

  \kappa_0 \bmod n = 0
  \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
  n \mid \chi(A).

Applied to the Descartes universe at \chi(A) = -6, the valid divisors restrict strictly to \{1, 2, 3, 6\}. \kappa_0 \bmod n mathematically zeroes out only spanning n \in \{1, 2, 3, 6\}. It rigorously evades zero for all other n (verifiably holding for n = 5, 7, 11, 13, \ldots).

(b) Obstruction persistence.

Evaluating at the root of unity q = e^{i\pi/\kappa}, the operating Kummer level isolates strictly to n = 2\kappa (reflecting the exact order mapping q inside \mathbb{G}_m). The functional obstruction \kappa_0 \bmod 2\kappa reduces to:

  \kappa_0 \bmod 2\kappa = 0
  \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
  2\kappa \mid \chi(A).

For \chi(A) = -6, 2\kappa \mid 6 permits exclusively \kappa \in \{1, 3\}, corresponding to q = e^{i\pi} or q = e^{i\pi/3}. At every other valid \kappa (universally capturing all \kappa \geq 4), the obstruction fundamentally persists squarely at that root of unity.

(c) The limit as kappa goes to infinity.

Pushing \kappa \to \infty (q \to 1) forces 2\kappa \to \infty. Consequently, 2\kappa \nmid 6 governs unconditionally for all \kappa \geq 4. The math yields:

  \kappa_0 \bmod 2\kappa  \neq  0
  \qquad\text{for all } \kappa \geq 4.

The topological component driving the NS obstruction rigorously avoids vanishing through the q \to 1 classical limit. Items 1–3 follow: the vanishing set is exactly \{n : n \mid \chi(A)\}, finite and complementary to the infinitely many levels where \kappa_0 \bmod n \neq 0.
